The failure is reproduced: a mock parent emitted `delegate_task`, but only the parent ran; the child was never invoked. I also created the requested branch, `fix/recursive-agent-delegation`, from `main`.

I could not implement or commit the fix. The invoked Claude API skill explicitly stops when it finds a non-Anthropic provider and asks whether to retain a provider-neutral implementation; this repository includes an OpenAI provider alongside Anthropic and Claude Code. Should I proceed with a provider-neutral implementation that follows the existing registry and handler patterns?
